sidebar_note: Your choices are saved on this computer.
heading: Welcome to your new system
subtitle: A few simple steps will get your computer ready. You can go back and change your choices at any time.
language_intro: Choose the language you want to use during setup and on your system.
keyboard_intro: Choose the keyboard layout that matches your keyboard.
clock_intro: Choose your time zone so the system clock shows the correct local time.
account_intro: Enter the name and username for the account you will use to sign in.
password_intro: Choose a password with at least 8 characters, then enter it again to confirm.
username_invalid: Use a username starting with a lowercase letter or underscore, with only lowercase letters, numbers, underscores, or hyphens.
password_short: Choose a password with at least 8 characters.
school_intro: School account connection can be added later. Leaving this blank is fine.
school_later: This field is an integration point for future school setup (for example, managed accounts and root policy). No connection will be made yet.
software_intro: Select apps to install. Recommended apps are selected for you; you can change this list.
theme_intro: Choose whether you prefer a dark or light appearance.
desktop_intro: Choose your desktop. XFCE is lightweight and simple; KDE Plasma offers more customization.
xfce_desc: XFCE — lightweight, quick, and straightforward; a good choice for older computers.
kde_desc: KDE Plasma — a modern, polished desktop with more customization options.
review_intro: Please read and accept the license before setup can begin. Installation may take several minutes.
eula_agree: I have read and agree to the EULA
eula_empty: The EULA file is empty. Add its text to eula.txt before installing.
eula_missing: The EULA file (eula.txt) has not been added yet. Add it before installing.
preview_eula: Preview mode does not change your computer. The production EULA will be shown here.
preview_complete: Preview complete. No system changes were made.
summary_save_failed: Setup finished, but the setup summary could not be updated: {error}
install_complete: Setup is complete. Save any work, then reboot to use your new system.
reboot_failed: Could not start the reboot. Please reboot from the system menu.
